provenance.taxonomy: Exact SGB IDs use UFPF taxonomy when available, otherwise Sid taxonomy. Named shared genera agree. UF GGB placeholders remain unresolved; unresolved Sid-only SGBs remain separate.
provenance.contribution: For each Sid visit and taxon: mean over reference profiles of abs(Sid share - reference share) / 2. Sum over all taxa equals mean pairwise Bray-Curtis at that rank. Across-visit ranking averages the five visits equally. These are descriptive contributions to abundance distance, not contributions to weighted UniFrac or causes of biological change.
provenance.direction: Sid share minus reference-group median share at each visit. Direction uses a 1e-12 tolerance. Reference 10th–90th percentiles describe between-person spread, not a confidence interval. No pseudocounts or p-values.
provenance.similarity: Median pairwise distance from each Sid profile to every eligible reference profile in a group. Lower means more similar for this metric. Reference baseline: median distance from each reference profile to all other profiles in its own group, excluding self; show median and IQR of these per-profile medians.
provenance.scope: Same retained SGB profiles and coverage screen as the existing comparison. One diagnosis-conflicted profile remains only in the all-UFPF driver view, never in named diagnosis groups. IBD samples followed initiation of bowel preparation. Repeated Sid visits are not independent people. Study effects, Sid input-unit semantics and full processing equivalence remain unresolved.
